verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party feature for exporting all account data (runs, logs, schedules, configuration) in open formats. Self-hosting, the open-source codebase, TRQL queries and the management API are adjacent: they ease portability or ad-hoc data access but are not a documented bulk-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
